question: In ומפאר before עדי־עד (at right), is any detached dagesh dot printed inside pe?
answer: No detached dagesh dot is visible inside pe.
visible_evidence: The pe has a dark inward bulb/terminal at its upper-left interior, visibly joined by a diagonal black stroke to the upper part of the glyph. The remaining pale interior is uninterrupted; no separate isolated black dot appears there. The connected terminal is therefore not evidence of a detached dagesh.
